%============================================================
%  RESEARCH PROPOSAL template
%  Start one with:  scripts/new_note.sh <Course> proposal "Course Name"
%    -> <Name>_<ID>_Proposal.tex, so the built PDF already has the submission name.
%  Build:  tectonic <file>.tex
%  Section order follows the usual proposal marking scheme; keep every section.
%============================================================
\documentclass[a4paper,12pt]{article}
\usepackage[top=2.4cm,bottom=2.4cm,left=2.5cm,right=2.5cm]{geometry}
% >>> SHARED PREAMBLE (templates/_report_preamble.tex, do not edit here)
% Shared preamble for graded documents: lab reports, assignment reports, proposals,
% exercise answers, English essays, presentation scripts. Edit
% templates/_report_preamble.tex, then run: python3 scripts/sync_preamble.py
% \documentclass, geometry, spacing and the "who and what" block stay per template.
\usepackage{amsmath,amssymb}
% Fonts: Times look. Under tectonic (XeTeX) use TeX Gyre Termes through fontspec,
% which also covers Vietnamese names; newtxmath for matching math. pdflatex falls back
% to newtxtext + newtxmath.
\usepackage{iftex}
\ifTUTeX
  \usepackage{newtxmath}
  \usepackage{fontspec}
  \setmainfont{texgyretermes}[Extension=.otf, UprightFont=*-regular, BoldFont=*-bold,
    ItalicFont=*-italic, BoldItalicFont=*-bolditalic]
\else
  \usepackage[T1]{fontenc}
  \usepackage[utf8]{inputenc}
  \usepackage{newtxtext,newtxmath}
\fi
\usepackage{setspace}
\usepackage{xcolor}
\usepackage{titlesec}
\usepackage{enumitem}
\usepackage{booktabs}
\usepackage{array}
\usepackage{tabularx}
\usepackage{microtype}
\usepackage{xurl}
\setlength{\emergencystretch}{2em}
\usepackage{graphicx}
\usepackage{float}
\usepackage{caption}
\usepackage{needspace}
\usepackage{listings}
\usepackage{tikz}
\usetikzlibrary{arrows.meta,positioning,calc,fit,shapes.geometric,shapes.multipart,backgrounds}
\usepackage{fancyhdr}
% bookmarks=false: math in a heading + PDF bookmarks hangs the compile forever
\usepackage[hidelinks,bookmarks=false]{hyperref}
\usepackage{tcolorbox}
\tcbuselibrary{skins,breakable}

% Figures live next to the .tex in figs/ (the notebook saves there too), so moving
% the .tex and the notebook together never breaks a path.
\graphicspath{{figs/}{../figs/}}

% ---- boxes (black and white, print friendly) ----
\newtcolorbox{notebox}{enhanced, breakable, colback=white, colframe=black, boxrule=0.4pt,
  arc=2pt, left=5pt, right=5pt, top=3pt, bottom=3pt}
\newtcolorbox{formulabox}[1][Key formulae]{enhanced, breakable, colback=white, colframe=black,
  boxrule=0.6pt, arc=2pt, left=5pt, right=5pt, top=3pt, bottom=3pt,
  title={\small\bfseries #1}, coltitle=black, colbacktitle=white}
\newtcolorbox{resultbox}{enhanced, breakable, colback=black!5, frame hidden, boxrule=0pt,
  arc=0pt, left=6pt, right=6pt, top=3pt, bottom=3pt}

% ---- code listings: short excerpts with a caption, never whole files ----
% \needspace{8\baselineskip} before a listing keeps it from splitting badly.
\lstdefinestyle{pyStyle}{language=Python, basicstyle=\ttfamily\small, keywordstyle=\bfseries,
  commentstyle=\itshape, breaklines=true, frame=single, numbers=left, numberstyle=\tiny,
  xleftmargin=15pt, captionpos=b, columns=fullflexible, keepspaces=true}
\lstdefinestyle{cppStyle}{style=pyStyle, language=C++}

% ---- TikZ styles for architecture / pipeline diagrams ----
\tikzset{
  container/.style={draw, rounded corners=2pt, align=center, font=\small, inner sep=5pt,
    minimum width=28mm, minimum height=10mm, fill=blue!4},
  optional/.style={container, dashed, fill=white},
  person/.style={draw, rounded corners=8pt, align=center, font=\small, fill=black!6, inner sep=5pt},
  extsys/.style={container, fill=black!8},
  lbl/.style={font=\scriptsize, align=center},
  arr/.style={-{Stealth[length=2mm]}, thick}
}

% ---- university logo: \UniLogo[height] ----
% Looks for logo.png next to the document, then assets/logo.png at the repo root from
% any folder depth (templates/, <Course>/notes/, <Course>/paper/<name>/, ...).
% No logo file -> prints nothing. Swap assets/logo.png to change university.
\def\LogoFile{}
\IfFileExists{logo.png}{\def\LogoFile{logo.png}}{%
\IfFileExists{assets/logo.png}{\def\LogoFile{assets/logo.png}}{%
\IfFileExists{../assets/logo.png}{\def\LogoFile{../assets/logo.png}}{%
\IfFileExists{../../assets/logo.png}{\def\LogoFile{../../assets/logo.png}}{%
\IfFileExists{../../../assets/logo.png}{\def\LogoFile{../../../assets/logo.png}}{}}}}}
\newcommand{\UniLogo}[1][1.6cm]{\ifx\LogoFile\empty\else\includegraphics[height=#1]{\LogoFile}\fi}
% \UniLogoBreak[h]: the logo plus a line break, both left out when there is no logo file
\newcommand{\UniLogoBreak}[1][1.6cm]{\ifx\LogoFile\empty\else\includegraphics[height=#1]{\LogoFile}\\[6pt]\fi}

\pagestyle{fancy}
\fancyhf{}
\cfoot{\small\thepage}
\renewcommand{\headrulewidth}{0pt}
% <<< SHARED PREAMBLE
